cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll find the office biscuits. Leave the delivery email shut; I can work this out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception signed for them. I'll tell everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send everyone downstairs. I'll make the announcement when we're all there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too late. They're downstairs opening the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll bring plates. Tell them to wait before announcing what's in the box.

reason: A accommodates the real snack retrieval while repeatedly reserving the next possible first announcement; the plate offer replaces an explanatory claim that the biscuits are not yet solved.
